title: CoinRun tokenizer 28.7M-label fixed-20k extension
question: At the same fixed 20,000-update recipe and latent interface as CR-TOK-0003, does the local 28.7M-label tokenizer improve held-out reconstruction over the 16.6M-label baseline?
reason: CR-TOK-0003 intentionally stopped at the 16.6M label, while the published CoinRun tokenizer scaling plot also includes a 28.7M label. The missing endpoint prevents the local capacity curve from covering the full published label range.
hypothesis: Increasing the symmetric encoder/decoder backbone from depth 5 and d_model 320 to depth 6 and d_model 384 will improve at least one final EMA clean, edge or temporal-change PSNR metric at the shared 20,000-update horizon because the 8.6M arm was still improving at 20,000 updates.
falsification: The hypothesis is rejected if the 28.7M-label arm completes the aligned protocol but improves none of final EMA clean, edge or temporal-change PSNR over the 16.6M-label baseline.

data.policy: Reuse the immutable CR-TOK-0003 structured train/eval records; no data is regenerated for this extension.

compute.estimated_budget: 20,000 optimizer updates; exact probe estimates 25,728,028,508,160 FLOPs/update and 5.145605701632e17 total training FLOPs. Expected wall time is approximately 6-9 A10 hours and must be measured.
compute.shutdown_policy: Use only the existing A10 after CR-TOK-0003 reaches terminal state. Keep a bounded shutdown timer beyond remaining ETA, then stop the instance after artifacts and ledger evidence are synchronized.

wandb.mode: online when the DSW host is authenticated; otherwise offline with later wandb sync

evaluation.comparison: Require exact equality of dataset path, seed, batch size, frames, batches, clip count and completed updates before computing n28.7m minus n16.6m deltas.
evaluation.selection_rule: Descriptive sum of final EMA clean, edge and temporal-change PSNR; no quality gate or eligibility filter.

downstream_guard.release_condition: Explicit user visual acceptance of the aligned n16.6m versus n28.7m grid, followed by a tokenizer-plus-dynamics interface smoke test.

success_criteria.rule: The exact 25,564,032-parameter n28.7m-label tokenizer trains from scratch for exactly 20,000 optimizer updates with scaling helpers disabled.
The run emits structured runtime identity, run state, metrics, telemetry and artifact ledgers, plus eight fixed-set periodic validation milestones with one stable validation-set SHA256.
All four 512-clip held-out evaluations at 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 20,000 completed updates finish with finite online and EMA global, edge and temporal-change metrics.
The n16.6m versus n28.7m comparison refuses mismatched evaluation identities and retains the aligned final reconstruction grid.
W&B mode and URL are reported truthfully; offline mode is never described as uploaded, and all evidence exists locally regardless of W&B availability.
Dynamics remains blocked until explicit visual acceptance.
